csv_project_name: Design for Mohican State Park Pool Improvements
csv_scope_of_work: The Ohio Department of Natural Resources (ODNR), through the Division of Parks and Watercraft is responsible for the management of all facilities at Mohican State Park. The Park campground currently includes a swimming pool and support buildings which have exceeded their useful life. At this stage, both the pool, its infrastructure, and operating systems are experiencing failures, and it has been determined they are in need of restoration and/or replacement. This Request for Qualifications (RFQ) is being issued to obtain Professional Design & Construction Administration (A/E) services for renovation/replacement work The selected team will develop site-specific plans and reconcile any existing studies for selected locations, beginning with the confirmation of facility and site assessments. These reconciliations will address the site utilization needs of various user groups, and utility infrastructure needs versus constraints. They will also include recommended scopes of construction projects and appropriate phasing.
csv_disciplines_requested: Architecture Services, Landscape Architecture, Surveying/GIS/Mapping, Construction/Project Management, Materials Testing, Hazardous Waste Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Structural Engineering, Hydrology/Hydraulics
